title: Soul Snack #33: What Inspired Gary to Change?
excerpt: In this Soul Snack, Gary offers a deeply personal reflection on the origins of his transformation—from living in anger to choosing a path of love and authentic power.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Snack, Gary offers a deeply personal reflection on the origins of his transformation—from living in anger to choosing a path of love and authentic power. Responding to a listener’s question, Gary shares how discovering the non-physical dimensions of life helped him understand the deeper consequences of his actions—not just on himself, but on the collective consciousness of humanity.

The Soul Snack explores how Gary came to see that emotions like anger, jealousy, and resentment are all expressions of fear. When he recognized his own role in contributing to the world’s suffering, he made a conscious choice: to stop fueling pain and start embodying love. 

Through practices of emotional awareness, intention-setting, and responsible choice he began aligning his life with the energy of gratitude, patience, and open-hearted presence.

The key to authentic power, Gary explains, is choosing to act from love even when fear arises. 

By becoming aware of our emotional energy via physical sensations—especially in the chest, throat, and solar plexus—we gain the ability to respond with care instead of react from fear.

Transformation begins with this choice.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (00:10) — The pivotal moment that sparked Gary’s personal transformation
  • (01:11) — How fear hides behind anger, jealousy, and superiority
  • (02:02) — Why your emotions contribute to collective human consciousness
  • (03:35) — How to recognize fear and love through physical sensations in the body

Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Take a moment to reflect on a recent time when you felt angry, jealous, or overwhelmed. Can you locate where those sensations appeared in your body—your throat, chest, or solar plexus? Instead of reacting or pushing the feeling away, pause. Ask yourself, “Is this a frightened part of me?” Then, set a new intention: respond from love. Whether it’s through silence, kindness, or simply not acting from fear, notice how this shifts your internal state. This is how you begin to change—moment by moment.
